#!/usr/bin/env python3
import csv
import pandas as pd

# File paths
INPUT_PATH = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
MISSINGNESS_REPORT_PATH = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
SELECTED_MATRIX_PATH = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"

# Read the input matrix
df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH)

# Identify indicator columns (all except city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ("city_id", "city_name", "year")]

# Compute missingness per indicator
total_rows = len(df)
report_rows = []
for col in indicator_columns:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_rows
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_rows.append({
        "indicator": col,
        "missing_count": missing_count,
        "missing_rate": missing_rate,
        "kept": "yes" if kept else "no"
    })

# Create missingness report DataFrame
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame(report_rows, columns=["indicator", "missing_count", "missing_rate", "kept"])

# Write the report CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (quote all fields)
missingness_report.to_csv(
    MISSINGNESS_REPORT_PATH,
    index=False,
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL
)

# Select indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = [row["indicator"] for row in report_rows if row["kept"] == "yes"]
selected_columns = ["city_id", "city_name", "year"] + kept_indicators

# Create selected matrix DataFrame
selected_matrix = df[selected_columns]

# Write the selected matrix CSV with RFC 4180 compliance (quote all fields)
selected_matrix.to_csv(
    SELECTED_MATRIX_PATH,
    index=False,
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL
)
</solution_file>
